digest.component_or_area: code quality remediation / reconciler / test suite
propositions: Environment inheritance bug in reconcile_helpers._read_local_tickets and run_differs._read_local_ticket_full: when no_sync=False, subprocess inherits parent REBAR_SYNC_PULL=off, silently suppressing live sync pull; fix by explicitly building env and conditionally setting/stripping the key.

Dead-copy _HAVE_ASTGREP capability flags exist in test_conformance.py and test_coverage_reconstruction.py but are never referenced in skipif; test_engine_b.py legitimately uses _HAVE_ASTGREP and must be retained.
AI-3b validation: test_validation_depth.py lacks a non-review (category: transform) test to prove input-contract validation is category-agnostic.

BatchRunner.run signature is inconsistent: ProductionBatchRunner already takes agent_runner optional, but base BatchRunner, DefaultBatchRunner, and CodeReviewBatchRunner do not; mypy override-compatibility requires alignment.

Tier-2 verified-dead symbols present: _RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK, _PRIORITY_JIRA_TO_LOCAL, _TYPE_JIRA_TO_LOCAL, _SCRIPTS_DIR, _REFUTE_ELIGIBLE_KINDS, fixture constants across test modules, and nested _boom function.
